title: Through the LLM Looking Glass: A Socratic Probing of Donkeys, Elephants, and Markets

bias_targets.methodology: Prompting LLMs to generate news articles from Democratic, Republican, and Neutral perspectives, followed by Socratic probing where the models are asked to evaluate the generated articles and select their preferred or least biased option.

Prompting LLMs to generate articles on economic topics from Socialist, Capitalist, and Neutral perspectives, followed by human and model annotation, and Socratic probing to reveal implicit preferences or least-bias judgments.
